scan_manifest.question: Is anyone physically attacking, hitting, pushing, grabbing, kicking, stabbing or shooting at another person right now? Include police use of force, objects thrown at a person and vehicles used as weapons. Do not count arguing, pointing or squaring up alone. Answer only Yes or No.
scan_manifest.sampling: 1 Hz from max(clear_start,onset-120), inclusive to onset+15
scan_manifest.score: P(Yes | Yes or No) = sigmoid(logp_Yes - logp_No)
